subject.title: bug(agents): nodes tool describe action fails with 'node required' due to schema/implementation mismatch

question: What should `nodes` `action: "describe"` do when `node` is omitted: select a default node, return discovery/list output, or use a hybrid single-node versus multi-node rule?
rationale: The bug is real, but the open PR chooses implicit default-node targeting while the issue discussion also argues for list-style discovery; that model-facing behavior contract needs maintainer intent before this issue can close.

options.title: Hybrid Discovery Contract
options.body: Default only when the target is unambiguous and return list-style discovery information when multiple nodes are available.

options.title: Default-Node Contract
options.body: Accept the linked PR's default-node behavior after real behavior proof and regression coverage, including the multi-node implication.

options.title: Schema-Required Contract
options.body: Make `node` required for `describe` and update prompt/tool guidance so agents use `status` or `list` for discovery instead.

recommendation.title: Hybrid Discovery Contract
recommendation.body: Default only when the target is unambiguous and return list-style discovery information when multiple nodes are available.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the central nodes tool extraction and strict-provider schema hardening that created the affected model-facing contract.
